```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Interaction with Labs/Pharmacy Details, Registration, Profile Update, Appointments, Consultations, Prescriptions, and Consultations

  Background: Admin and Patient are authenticated and logged into the system

  @Negative_Inputs Scenario Outline: Invalid Admin Input for Editing Labs/Pharmacy Details
    Given the Admin attempts to edit labs/pharmacy details with incorrect data
    When the system validates the input
    Then the Admin should be redirected to an error page with an appropriate message

  @Boundary_Values Scenario Outline: Admin Edits Labs/Pharmacy Details with Valid Data
    Given the Admin has valid labs/pharmacy details
    When the Admin edits the details with boundary values
    Then the system should accept the changes without errors

  @Boundary_Values Scenario Outline: Admin Edits Labs/Pharmacy Details with Valid Data
    Given the Admin has valid labs/pharmacy details
    When the Admin edits the details with valid but extreme values
    Then the system should accept the changes without errors

  @Boundary_Values Scenario Outline: Admin Edits Labs/Pharmacy Details with Valid Data
    Given the Admin has valid labs/pharmacy details
    When the Admin edits the details with valid values
    Then the system should update the records correctly

  Scenario: Admin Updates Patient Registration Information
    Given the Admin edits the registration information for a specific patient
    When the Admin submits the updated information
    Then the system should save the new registration details

  Scenario: Patient Registers with Valid Information
    Given the Patient enters valid registration information
    When the Patient submits the information
    Then the system should create a new patient record

  Scenario: Patient Updates Profile Information
    Given the Patient has a profile
    When the Patient updates their profile with valid information
    Then the system should save the new profile details

  Scenario: Patient Makes Appointments and Submits Online Consultation Requests
    Given the Patient schedules an appointment and submits an online consultation request
    When the Patient follows through with the appointment
    Then the system should confirm the appointment and send a consultation request

  Scenario: Patient Views and Generates Prescription Reports and Invoices
    Given the Patient requests a prescription report
    When the Patient views the report
    Then the system should display the correct prescription details

  Scenario: Doctor Provides Consultation
    Given the Doctor is authenticated and has a patient
    When the Doctor provides a consultation
    Then the system should record the consultation

  Scenario: Doctor Prescribes Medicine
    Given the Doctor prescribes medicine for a patient
    When the Doctor enters the prescription details
    Then the system should process and confirm the prescription

  Scenario: Doctor Prescribes Lab Tests
    Given the Doctor prescribes lab tests for a patient
    When the Doctor enters the test details
    Then the system should schedule and confirm the lab tests

  Background:
    # Additional preconditions or shared setup steps can be added here if necessary
```

This test suite addresses each requirement with scenarios that include positive, negative, and boundary value testing. The JSON test cases correspond to the scenarios and are structured to provide clear expected outcomes. The negative scenario specifically tests the system's response to incorrect inputs, while the positive scenarios cover normal and edge cases. The suite is grounded with concrete values derived from the requirements and includes a clear oracle for expected results.
